semanticStages.description: The complete positive antecedent passes every selected semantic check.
The complete case input envelope fails strict structural decoding before protocol interpretation.
The network ID, tag, deployment, and runtime network relation fails.
A selected deployment manifest fact or exact manifest identity fails.
TxContextFv1 magic, version, lengths, record order, or canonical grammar fails.
TxContextFv1 has truncation, skipped bytes, duplicated material, or an unconsumed suffix.
The frozen PCTX preimage, domain, codec version, or inclusion boundary identity fails.
A supplied digest is trusted or the canonical TxContextFv1 digest does not recompute exactly.
A transaction/config-derived PAST field diverges from direct projection or the frozen 589-byte PAST identity.
Raw token introspection cannot unambiguously establish the claimed semantic token record.
The raw token projection does not byte-match the exact selected deployment token expectation.
A complete selected locking bytecode differs, including nonexecuted suffix bytes.
Typed placeholders, role, ordinal, source, successor, output hash, or provenance map binding fails.
A selected complete-lock identity or genesis-outpoint derivation graph contains a prohibited cycle.
Anchor/carrier wrapper magic, version, ordinal, count, lengths, fields, or full consumption fails.
Sole-anchor PAST, profile, manifest, count, checkpoint, or state-side fact binding fails.
The proof-session root is supplied as authority, self-referential, or differs from recomputation over ordered raw sections and frozen inputs.
A leaf, path, vector, membership result, or same-anchor relation differs from recomputation using raw payloads.
Ordered raw section, local checkpoint, ordinal, cross-carrier, or session-section binding fails.
The selected proof grammar omits, duplicates, overlaps, misassigns, or leaves unconsumed proof bytes.
A push opcode, length, element encoding, or decoded-opcode scan is noncanonical or inconsistent.
A selected complete locking or unlocking script fails consensus or standardness script boundaries.
The complete transaction fails consensus or standardness transaction boundaries.
Complete-transaction sibling unlocking/session binding fails despite any independent funding authorization.
A numerical or qualification claim is refused because required selected artifacts or exact overhead derivation are absent.

vocabularyRule: Every future expectation row has exactly one semantic stage from this finite vocabulary. Earlier-stage antecedents must pass so the named stage is observable. Implementation-native messages and result-derived stages are evidence only and never expectations.
